# Pratishtha Digital Solutions

> Pratishtha Digital Solutions is a digital marketing, branding, and online reputation management agency headquartered in Maharashtra, India. We help businesses build Google visibility, customer trust, and sustainable growth.

Tagline: Building Reputation. Creating Impact.

## About

Pratishtha Digital Solutions (also called Pratishtha Digital) is a professional digital presence and reputation consulting firm. We serve clients across India with ethical digital marketing, Google Business Profile optimization, Local SEO, websites, social media, advertising, WhatsApp marketing, and branding.

Vision: To become India's most trusted Digital Reputation & Business Growth Agency by helping businesses establish a strong online presence, build customer trust, and achieve sustainable growth.

Mission: Help local businesses, hotels, hospitals, builders, restaurants, clinics, startups, and entrepreneurs build a powerful digital identity through ethical digital marketing, Google visibility, branding, and online reputation management.

USP: We don't just provide digital marketing — we build a business's digital reputation, increase online visibility, strengthen customer trust, and create sustainable growth through Google, SEO, branding, websites, and social media.

## Core services

1. Google Business Profile — setup, verification guidance, Google Maps listing, optimization, categories, description writing, photos, products/services setup, weekly Google posts, Q&A management, reviews strategy, insights monitoring
2. Local SEO & Website SEO — ranking improvement, SEO audit, technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, keyword research, competitor analysis, meta titles/descriptions, image optimization, schema markup, internal linking, speed optimization, content SEO, backlink strategy, monthly SEO reports
3. Social Media Management — Instagram & Facebook management, content calendar, graphic design, carousels, stories, reels strategy, captions, hashtag research, community management, profile optimization
4. Website Services — business/corporate/portfolio websites, landing pages, optimization, maintenance, domain/hosting/SSL guidance, performance optimization
5. Branding — personal branding, business branding, brand positioning, brand identity, digital presence, company profile, brochure design, presentation design
6. Advertising & Lead Generation — Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube), Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, remarketing, conversion tracking, performance optimization
7. Online Reputation Management — Google review management, negative review response, customer trust building, brand reputation, online presence management
8. WhatsApp & Communication — WhatsApp Business setup, content writing, bulk/broadcast strategy, SMS content, festival and promotional messages, campaign planning
9. Business Growth Consulting — local business marketing, digital consulting, marketing strategy, customer acquisition, digital transformation

## Who we help / target clients

Hotels, resorts, restaurants, cafes, hospitals, clinics, doctors, builders, real estate companies, schools, colleges, coaching institutes, jewellery shops, garment businesses, retail stores, medical stores, gyms, salons, spas, interior designers, architects, startups, small businesses, MSMEs, manufacturing companies, local businesses, professionals, influencers, public personalities, political leaders, NGOs, event organizers, travel agencies.

## Problems we solve

- Business not visible on Google or Google Maps
- Poor or unmanaged Google reviews
- Low website traffic and no leads
- Weak social media presence
- Poor brand image / low online trust
- No digital strategy, SEO, or website
- Poor customer engagement

## Benefits clients receive

More visibility, higher Google rankings, more phone calls, more website traffic, better reviews, more leads, higher brand trust, professional online image, long-term business growth.
